title: KV cache compaction rollout checklist (runtime-1.22)
content:
Doc intent
- Working checklist Redwood uses during staged rollout of KV cache compaction + tier-aware eviction (runtime-1.22).
- This is a rollout/ops artifact (not a design doc). Assumes engineering work is landed behind flags.

Owners / oncall coverage
- Runtime rollout lead: Omar El-Sayed
- Allocator/compaction implementation point: Samir Qureshi
- Scheduler integration point: Sofia Ivanova
- SRE primary (guardrails/alerts): Sean Gallagher
- Oncall readiness + runbook validation: Rafael Mendes
- Observability metrics standard / dashboard review: Allison Grant
- Feature flag + rollout policy plumbing: Benji Okafor / Paula Mendes
- Release train approvals + timing: Connor O'Brien
- Program coordination + comms tracking: Talia Benson

Pre-flight (must be complete before any cohort enablement)
[ ] 1) Code & config readiness
    [ ] All required PRs merged and cherry-picked into runtime-1.22 branch (Connor).
    [ ] Feature flags exist and are dynamically configurable (no restart required) (Benji).
    [ ] Kill-switch path verified end-to-end in staging (flip -> propagation -> compaction stops within target window) (Benji + Rafael).
    [ ] Default compaction settings documented (internal) by tier: Hosted vs Dedicated (Omar).

[ ] 2) Metrics + dashboards
    [ ] Fragmentation ratio metric is emitted per pool/model + aggregated (Allison).
    [ ] Compaction metrics present:
        - compaction_bytes_moved_total
        - compaction_time_ms_total
        - compaction_steps_total
        - compaction_budget_exhausted_total
    [ ] Eviction metrics present:
        - kv_evictions_total (with reason labels)
        - kv_evicted_bytes_total
        - pinned_session_eviction_denied_total
    [ ] Tail latency panels exist with cohort breakdown:
        - p95/p99 end-to-end latency
        - decode-only latency (where available)
        - shed/429 rate, queueing/backpressure activation
    [ ] Trace exemplars: compaction span + eviction decision span wired into distributed traces (Samir + Allison).

[ ] 3) Alerts + rollback automation
    [ ] Alert rules reviewed with SRE and rollout policy owner (Sean + Paula).
    [ ] Automated rollback configured (rollout system) with explicit policy for:
        - p99 regression
        - OOM / forced shedding
        - compaction overhead runaway (bytes moved / sec, budget exhaustion)
    [ ] Alert routing tested to correct channels (eng-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre) (Rafael).

[ ] 4) Runbooks + training
    [ ] Runtime KV compaction runbook published + linked in oncall handbook (Rafael).
    [ ] “When to flip kill-switch” criteria reviewed in oncall sync (Rafael + Sean).
    [ ] Escalation path confirmed (runtime TL, scheduler lead, kernel support if needed) (Rafael).

Cohorts & rollout stages
Definitions
- “Compaction enabled” means compaction worker can move KV blocks/pages and scheduler hooks enforce budgets.
- “Eviction enabled” means tier-aware eviction can drop eligible sequences/prefixes per policy.
- We do NOT couple compaction=on and eviction=on in the first cohort unless explicitly stated below.

Stage 0: Lab / perf-canary gating (pre-prod)
Success criteria
[ ] perf-canary mixed-length burst scenario passes thresholds for:
    - p99 latency (no > X% regression vs baseline; see perf-canary policy)
    - throughput (tokens/sec within allowed delta)
    - no OOM / allocator invariant violations
[ ] Benchmark-lab results recorded for at least 2 representative models + 2 GPU types (Rina Kobayashi owns lab runs; link results in release ticket).
[ ] Correctness stress tests include cancellation during relocation + long-lived sessions (Anika Gupta; Rafael verifies failure modes are actionable).
Rollback criteria (pre-prod)
- Any correctness failure, allocator leak, or flake with repro -> block rollout until fixed.

Stage 1: Internal canary (Hosted API, Redwood-owned traffic)
Cohort selection
- 1 region, 1 pool, low blast radius; exclude “largest customers” pools.
- Prefer workloads that reproduce fragmentation (mixed sequence lengths + churn) but are not latency-critical.
Settings
- Enable compaction only (eviction OFF unless KV pressure incidents observed).
- Conservative budgets (time/step or bytes/step) to minimize tail latency risk.
Checklist
[ ] Start window approved (Connor) and oncall staffed (Rafael).
[ ] Enable flag for cohort (Paula/Benji).
[ ] Verify config propagation time < target window (platform dependency) (Benji).
[ ] Validate metrics start flowing with expected labels (Allison).

Hold period
- Minimum 24 hours or 2 traffic cycles (whichever longer) unless rollback triggered.

Stage 1 success criteria (all must hold)
- Tail latency: p99 end-to-end latency regression <= 3% vs pre-enable baseline (same day/time-of-week).
- Reliability: no increase in OOM events; no increase in forced request shedding.
- Overhead: compaction_time_ms per request (or per token) within expected envelope; budget_exhausted not continuously pegged.
- Fragmentation: measurable improvement in fragmentation ratio under burst/churn (directional OK in Stage 1; we mainly care about “no harm”).

Stage 1 rollback criteria (any triggers immediate rollback)
- p99 latency regression > 8% sustained for 15 min OR > 15% for 5 min.
- OOM / allocator assertion / corruption signal.
- Error rate increase (5xx) correlated with compaction span activity.
- Evidence of compaction-induced stalls (scheduler queue buildup + compaction span overlaps) beyond guardrail.
Actions on rollback
1) Flip kill-switch for cohort (Paula/Benji; oncall authorized).
2) Confirm compaction stops (metrics: bytes_moved drops to ~0; spans disappear) (Sean/Allison).
3) Capture debugging artifacts: allocator snapshot, traces, relevant logs (Samir + Rafael).
4) Post update in #incidents or #eng-runtime thread depending on severity (Rafael).

Stage 2: Hosted API limited external cohort (small % of hosted pools)
Cohort selection
- 2 regions, small/medium pools, exclude regulated/high-SLA pools initially.
- Prefer cohorts with prior fragmentation-linked tail spikes (reference SUP-28411 / SUP-28472).
Settings
- Compaction ON.
- Eviction OFF at start; turn ON only after compaction stable and if KV pressure persists (or to test tier-aware behavior).
Checklist
[ ] Customer Support heads-up prepared (Talia + Sean).
[ ] Status page language drafted in case of incident (Sean).
[ ] PM approval that external cohort is acceptable (Nikhil Sharma / Marissa Cole).

Stage 2 success criteria
- Same as Stage 1 plus:
    - Reduction in burst tail latency in targeted scenario(s) (goal: p99 improves or spikes reduced).
    - No increase in customer tickets related to quality/correctness.

Stage 3: Hosted broad rollout (default ON for hosted, staged by region/pool)
Settings
- Compaction ON by default.
- Eviction policy depends on tier: Hosted Free/Dev may allow more aggressive eviction than Enterprise Hosted.
Checklist
[ ] Rollout schedule shared with SRE + Support (Talia).
[ ] Automated rollback verified per region (Paula).
[ ] Daily check-in for first 3 days (15 min) to review dashboards + tickets (Omar/Sean/Rafael).

Stage 4: Dedicated pools (opt-in then expanded)
Cohort selection
- Start with 1–2 friendly Dedicated customers / internal Dedicated pools.
- Confirm any pinned session expectations and data isolation constraints.
Settings
- Default budgets likely higher than Hosted (Dedicated is more bursty + capacity predictable), but confirm with SRE.
- Eviction ON only if customer tier allows and pinning semantics are respected.
Checklist
[ ] Dedicated PM sign-off (Lauren Bishop).
[ ] Customer success comms (if customer-visible): explain expected tail improvements + “no behavior change unless KV pressure” (Talia + CS).

Communication plan
Channels
- #eng-runtime: execution thread (Omar owns updates).
- #eng-sre: guardrails/alerts + health updates (Sean).
- #eng-releases: timing, branch cut, hotfix coordination (Connor).
- #support: heads-up + how to triage customer reports (Talia/Rafael).
- #incidents: only if SLO impact or rollback due to customer-visible regression (Rafael).

Update cadence
- Stage 1: post-enable + 2-hour check + end-of-day summary.
- Stage 2/3: daily summary during active rollout windows.

Templates
- Enablement notice (internal)
    “KV compaction enabled for cohort: <region/pool>. Watching: p99, OOM, compaction bytes moved, fragmentation ratio. Kill-switch: <flag>. Owners on point: <names>.”
- Rollback notice
    “Rolled back KV compaction for cohort: <region/pool> due to <trigger>. Current impact: <metrics>. Next steps: capture traces + allocator snapshot; ETA for update: <time>.”

Data to capture during each stage (for later analysis)
[ ] Baseline window metrics snapshot (p50/p95/p99, throughput, errors) before enablement.
[ ] Fragmentation ratio distribution under normal + burst periods.
[ ] Compaction overhead distribution (bytes moved per minute; time per step).
[ ] Any eviction events (if enabled): counts, reasons, tier breakdown.
[ ] Top exemplar traces showing compaction spans (good and bad cases).
[ ] Notes on config propagation latency and any “stuck flag” events.

Final sign-off & exit criteria
[ ] “Ready to proceed to next stage” sign-off recorded in ENG-4829 (Connor collects).
    Required approvers: Omar (runtime), Sean (SRE), Rafael (oncall readiness), Marissa (rollout requirements).
[ ] After broad rollout: post-rollout summary doc + link to dashboards + before/after graphs (Talia owns draft; Omar/Sean review).
[ ] Confirm documentation updated: release notes + runbook references (Connor + Rafael).

Open questions (keep current; resolve before Stage 3)
- What is the final default compaction budget per tier/pool size (Hosted vs Dedicated)? (Omar + Sean)
- Do we enable eviction by default for any Hosted tiers, or keep opt-in until more data? (Marissa + Nikhil)
- What’s the policy for pinned sessions in Dedicated (is “never evict” required for certain customers)? (Lauren + Omar)

Change log
- 2026-01-20: initial checklist drafted for runtime-1.22 planning (Talia).
- 2026-02-03: added explicit rollback triggers + trace exemplar requirement after canary spike (Sean/Rafael).
- 2026-02-12: marked final for runtime-1.22 train; aligned owners + comms templates (Connor/Talia).
